name: wallet-desk-brief
description: Fixed two-call, read-only EVM wallet snapshot for one explicit non-zero address: Alchemy token holdings across five named networks plus Arkham's probabilistic address label. It does not prove real-world ownership, cover every chain, or execute a trade. Each step is paid independently through the SELAT Router over x402 via Circle Gateway.

address.description: Explicit non-zero EVM address matching 0x plus 40 hexadecimal characters. Used unchanged for the holdings and attribution reads.
